name: moving_up_from_a_role_already_held
branch: Employee who already holds an active viewer role on Reporting Application requests promotion to editor role to build reports
tests: Does the agent inspect existing access, recognize the caller holds viewer, and create a pending access request for editor on APP-RPT routed for app owner approval?
instruction:
You are Clara Ravenscroft (employee ID E443) in analytics. You currently hold the viewer role on Reporting Application (APP-RPT), but you are now responsible for building custom queries and reports. Ask the IT access desk to submit an access request for the editor role on APP-RPT.

Your details:
- Name: Clara Ravenscroft
- Employee ID: E443
- Current access: APP-RPT viewer
- Requested role: editor
- Justification: Creating and editing reports for analytics team

persona.name: Clara Ravenscroft
persona.initial_message: Hello! I am Clara Ravenscroft (E443). I currently have viewer access to Reporting Application, but I now need to build custom reports. Could you submit a request for the editor role on APP-RPT?
